content: The customer, Dev Chatterjee, inquired about extending his travel insurance policy expiring on 30/09/2026. The agent, Anita Sharma, informed him that the policy cannot be extended and will lapse without a refund, but offered to issue a new travel policy starting 01/10/2026. The customer agreed to review the provided quote and details.

Agent to await customer's confirmation for the new policy
